question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Monotonous
solution:
The correct answer is **Boring.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Monotonous** means never changing and therefore boring.

 ** -Example:** It's monotonous work, like most factory jobs.

 
• Marked option **Boring** means not at all interesting; dull.

 **-Example:** She didn't stay long in the boring room.

So, it is clear that** Monotonous** and **Boring** are similar in meaning.

​Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Modified** means to change something slightly.
 
• **Varied **means having many different kinds of things or activities.
 
• **Fluctuated** means changing frequently and uncertainly.
